issues.text: Marquee seam has no 24px gap: the figure gets `last:mr-0` (specificity 0,2,0 as `.last\:mr-0:last-child`) which beats the `md:mr-6` override (0,1,0, media queries add no specificity), so run 1's fig.05 tile butts directly against run 2's fig.01 tile with 0px between them. Every other inter-tile gap measures exactly 24px, so once per loop two 546px photos touch. Fix: scope the reset to the scroller only (e.g. `max-md:last:mr-0`) so both runs keep the 24px right margin at >=768px. Loop stays seamless either way (run 2232 -> 2256, -50% still equals one run).

Tile corner radius measures ~6px (Tailwind's default `rounded-md`, since the theme defines --radius-xs/-sm/-pill but no --radius-md); spec §2 Tiles calls for `border-radius: 8px`. Use `rounded-lg` or an explicit 8px value.

Geometry matches the spec exactly: section 1440x428, 12px top/bottom padding, tile height 404px, gaps 24px, measured tile widths 320 / 404 (and the clipped 546 run-1 tile), tile hairline #ECECEC on both light and dark photography.

First tile is clipped at x=0 rather than starting at the 12px inset - that is the marquee (spec §6.3) caught mid-translate, not a padding bug. Tile order and chip copy read fig.01 / fig.02 / fig.03 / fig.02 as drawn, including the deliberate repeat.

Figure chips correct: 24/32/32/24 padding, 8px Overpass Mono 700 at 0.01em uppercase white, whole chip at opacity 0.64, and the radial top-left scrim is present (sampled falloff on tile 2 runs ~122 -> ~187 luminance from 6px to 100px out). Section carries no heading, eyebrow or body copy and adds no elements beyond the five tiles.
Same missing 24px marquee seam gap as desktop - the second run renders from 768px up, so run 1's last tile abuts run 2's first tile with no separation.

No Figma tablet mock. At 768px the build correctly applies the spec's `>= 768` rule (strip as drawn): section 768x429, 12px padding, 404px tile height, 320px tile width, 24px gaps, marquee active, no clipped or unreadable content.
Tile corner radius ~6px vs the spec's 8px (same `rounded-md` token gap as desktop).

No Figma mobile mock. The build matches the spec's `< 768` intent precisely: 12px section padding, tile height 242px = min(404px, 62vw) at 390w, first tile 327px wide (546/404 ratio held), 24px gap, native `overflow-x: auto` snap scroller with `scroll-padding: 12px` and hidden scrollbar, second marquee run suppressed. No viewport overflow, no clipped text.
fig.01 chip renders at its full 8px mono size over the dark headland - legible, scrim present, chip not scaled down with the tile (spec does not ask it to be).

summary: The media strip is essentially spec-exact at every breakpoint - tile widths, 404px height, 24px gaps, 12px padding, #ECECEC hairlines, chip scrims and the 62vw mobile scroller all measure correct - with one real defect: a CSS specificity slip drops the 24px gap at the marquee seam so fig.05 and fig.01 touch once per loop, plus a 6px-vs-8px tile radius.
